behaviour: Every agent session starts with a delivery requirements summary of at most fifty words, and agentihooks init ends with the same line: deliver each change as one complete pull request, split it in two only when it changes more than AGENTIHOOKS_CODEREVIEW_FILELIMIT files (default 20), never split smaller for size alone, and always deliver or offer the source root fix, never a workaround the user did not ask for. SessionStart injects it on the Claude, Codex and Copilot targets, for standalone sessions and swarm seats alike, ranked with the enforcements so a full context budget keeps it. A first import under a temporary common injector replacement does not retain that replacement for later SessionStart calls.
seam: hooks.context.delivery_requirements.render and summary, hooks.hook_manager.main on a SessionStart payload per target, and scripts.install.main on an init command, hooks.context.delivery_requirements.inject_on_session_start
